patterns.text: Bash is the noisiest tool every week, with error rates far above read, grep, or edit.
claude-opus-5 eats 62-71% of weekly spend even when it logs fewer messages than gpt-5.6-sol.
gpt-5.6-sol carries more message volume than claude-opus-5 every week, at a fraction of the cost per message.
Advisor-doctrine sessions land in the top-5 costliest sessions of the week, every week.
Weekly cost fell every week in August, down 51% from the first week to the last.
The tofu project family holds top spend most weeks and swallows 74-91% of prompts by month's end.

questions: Is August's 51% cost drop a real usage decline or a shift to cheaper models/workflows?
Does the gpt-5.6-sol/opus split reflect a fixed main-vs-advisor routing rule across all projects?
